entities.summary: Carlo III, Duke of Parma was a monarchs & rulers in Lucca (1823-01-14, Lucca – 1854-03-27) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and empire and colonial dynamics. Established dynastic legacies and territorial boundaries.
